# Install packages if necessary

library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(BayesFactor)

# Read the Excel file
my_data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("betas_ses7DLD_vs_TYP_lIFGop.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet1") # specify excel file
roi <- "lIFGop"
beta_variable <- paste0("Beta_estimates_", roi)

#########################do not edit below###############################
# Check the imported column names
names(my_data)

# Compute beta estimates for each subject
my_data <- my_data %>%
  mutate(
    Beta_R1 = (R1P_O + R1P_R) - 2*R1P_C,
    Beta_R2 = (R2P_O + R2P_R) - 2*R2P_C,
    !!beta_variable := (Beta_R1 + Beta_R2) / 2
  )

# Ensure Group is treated as a categorical variable
my_data$Group <- factor(my_data$Group)

# View subject-level beta estimates
# View subject-level beta estimates
my_data %>%
  select(ID, Group, Beta_R1, Beta_R2, all_of(beta_variable)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Descriptive statistics by group
summary_results <- my_data %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(.data[[beta_variable]])),
    mean = mean(.data[[beta_variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(.data[[beta_variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(.data[[beta_variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nROI:", roi, "\n")
cat("Outcome variable:", beta_variable, "\n")
cat("\nDescriptive summary by group:\n")
print(summary_results)

# ==============================
# Bayesian independent two-sample t-test
# ==============================
bf_result <- ttestBF(
  formula = as.formula(
    paste(beta_variable, "~ Group")
  ),
  data = my_data,
  nullInterval = NULL
)

cat("\nBayesian two-sample t-test:\n")
print(bf_result)

# ==============================
# Extract BF10 and calculate BF01
# ==============================
BF10 <- as.numeric(
  extractBF(bf_result, onlybf = TRUE)
)

BF01 <- 1 / BF10

cat("\nBF10 =", round(BF10, 4), "\n")
cat("BF01 =", round(BF01, 4), "\n")

# ==============================
# Interpret BF01
# ==============================
if (BF01 > 10) {
  interpretation <- "Strong evidence for the null hypothesis: no group difference."
} else if (BF01 >= 3) {
  interpretation <- "Moderate evidence for the null hypothesis: no group difference."
} else if (BF01 > 1/3) {
  interpretation <- "Evidence is inconclusive or anecdotal."
} else {
  interpretation <- "Evidence favors the alternative hypothesis: a group difference."
}

cat("\nInterpretation:\n")
cat(interpretation, "\n")
